result.quote:
Congruent Condition (n = 118)
Mean RT | 1.000 | 0.001 | 0.743 | 0.998–1.003
Cost (Incongruent – Congruent) (n = 115)

¶Unhealthy diet: meeting ≥2 of the following: insufficient vegetable intake (<300 g/day), insufficient fruit intake (<200 g/day), low dietary fiber intake (<25 g/day), excessive red meat consumption (>500 g/week), high-salt diet (moderate to salty taste preferences, or the consumption of takeout meals, processed meats, pickled vegetables, fermented bean curd or salty snacks at least once per week) and frequent consumption of processed meat (consumption of processed meat at least once per week).
result.reason: Table 2 reports each listed prevalence and defines unhealthy diet as meeting at least two of the listed habits, with 95.8% classified as having an unhealthy diet.
